entities.name: Immaculate Conception Cathedral, Taipei
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Immaculate Conception Cathedral is a Roman Catholic cathedral in Datong District, Taipei, Taiwan. The Latin Rite church serves as the see of the Metropolitan Archdiocese of Taipei created by Pope Pius XII with the Bull "Gravia illa Christi".
